summary: Public ESP32/M5Stack firmware collection for heterogeneous telemetry, observer, UI and experimental worker nodes with explicit protocol and recovery boundaries.
implemented_scope: public firmware sketches for multiple ESP32/M5Stack nodes
source assembly for selected multi-tab sketches
CI compilation/static checks for selected public build paths
credential separation through examples/ignored local configuration
invariants: sensor truth must be distinguishable from prediction, memory and UI fiction
observer-only nodes must not increase submit pressure
adaptive work scheduling must not alter SHA-256, target math, pool difficulty or submit semantics
recovery and stale-node handling must remain inspectable
not_claimed: precognition or access to future physical information
autonomous authority over people or external systems
